# pstack source fixture

Pinned to Cursor Plugins commit `5866df557357d005b3c0c9d3da0d9e739b4bdde3`.

The three Skill records and both pstack manifests were fetched from this exact revision. Each Skill record stores its immutable source URL, Git blob SHA, and SHA-256 of the fetched UTF-8 content.
